name: Should I add a full bathroom or a half bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I add a full bathroom or a half bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between a full bathroom (with a shower or tub) and a half bathroom (toilet and sink only) depends on your home's layout, your family's needs, and your budget. A full bathroom addition often provides a higher return on investment and greater functionality, especially in homes with few existing bathrooms. Consider the intended use of the space; a half bath might suffice for guest use, while a full bath is necessary for expanding living space for family members.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose between a full or half bathroom based on your home's needs, budget, and desired functionality for family or guests.
